raw_variability.cause: FILES[].url query parameter _efd is regenerated on each crm.activity.list/get for email attachments. file id, order, count, and non-URL metadata did not change.

call_recording.note: No _efd on observed VOXIMPLANT recordings. list vs get URL bytes were identical. fileId still follows FILES[].id and can be replaced after the call.

stable_file_identity.call_recording_caveat: FILES[].id is stable across re-reads of the same attachment bytes, but Bitrix can replace the recording file with a new id after the call. That is a revision of the same activity, not a new activity. Use activity ID + ORIGIN_ID for call identity; treat file id as attachment revision.

recommended_semantic_file_projection.sort: sorted unique ids, then remaining semantic fields by id

hashes.RAW_FILES_HASH: entire FILES object as returned; changes when _efd rotates even if attachments are the same
hashes.ID_ONLY_HASH: sorted file ids only; stable for unchanged email attachments; changes if Bitrix replaces a call recording file
hashes.SEMANTIC_FILES_HASH: same as ID_ONLY on this portal because name/type/size are not returned

recommended_semantic_file_projection.new_real_file_changes_semantic_hash: NOT PRACTICALLY TESTED (no new email attachment during experiment). Call recording replacement 1012207→1012215 DID change ID_ONLY/SEMANTIC hashes and LAST_UPDATED.

list_vs_get.implication: Production incremental must keep crm.activity.list (with select FILES,COMMUNICATIONS). crm.activity.get is useful for a second FILES look, not as the sole activity source.

call_experiment.note: Live T1–T5 caught on a lead (OWNER_TYPE_ID=1), not a deal. Missed incoming VOXIMPLANT call. A separate answered call 663127 (also a lead) showed recording file replacement. Deal call 663089 (deal 18951) was read once after completion with recording already present.

on_recording_appear_empty_to_first.note: Missed call 663125 never got FILES. Answered 663127 already had FILES when first listed.

last_updated_behavior.cursor_implication: Observed completion and recording-file replacement both moved LAST_UPDATED, so activity.list >=LAST_UPDATED would see those revisions. Empty→first file vs LAST_UPDATED was not directly observed.

answered_call_file_replacement_663127.note: Answered VOXIMPLANT call first seen already completed with FILES; ~5 min later file id replaced and LAST_UPDATED moved. Not the T1 in-progress catch.

deal_call_already_complete_663089.list_vs_get: same FILES ids; COMMUNICATIONS only on list

stable_recording_identity_without_url.FILES[].id: NOT always stable: can be replaced after completion
stable_recording_identity_without_url.url: do not use; email URLs rotate _efd; call URLs omit _efd but fileId follows FILES[].id

historical_deal_18733.note: Historical correlation only: LAST_UPDATED is typically a few minutes after END_TIME. Does not by itself prove recording late-fill updates LAST_UPDATED.

list_vs_get.live_call_663125: only COMMUNICATIONS present on list, absent on get; FILES empty both
list_vs_get.static_completed_calls_with_and_without_: same pattern: list_only=COMMUNICATIONS; FILES ids match; call recording URLs identical

incremental_risk.recording_file_replacement: LOW on observed case: LAST_UPDATED moved with new file id
incremental_risk.recording_empty_to_first_unwatched: MEDIUM remaining: not proven. Production already does extra crm.activity.get when FILES empty (refresh_missing_call_files).
incremental_risk.email_files_hash_on_FULL: HIGH for canonical/snapshot if RAW FILES hashed: _efd rotates without LAST_UPDATED, so FULL re-read creates false revisions; incremental cursor correctly does not re-fetch those emails

canonical_rules_now_proven: Bitrix activity ID is stable across call in-progress → completed (observed 663125).
ORIGIN_ID (VI_externalCall.*) is present from first sight and stayed stable on observed calls.
Email FILES[].id is the stable attachment identity; FILES[].url._efd is technical noise and is why files_hash moved on FULL for 9 old emails.
Same real email attachment set → same ID_ONLY_HASH and SEMANTIC_FILES_HASH across A/B/Z and two live reads; RAW_FILES_HASH changes.
crm.activity.get is not a richer copy of crm.activity.list: it omits COMMUNICATIONS even if select includes it; FILES ids match list.
Call completion (COMPLETED N→Y, STATUS 1→2) updates LAST_UPDATED.
Call recording FILES[].id can be replaced after completion; LAST_UPDATED moved with that replacement (663127).
SETTINGS.MISSED_CALL can be true while COMPLETED is still N.
VOXIMPLANT recording URLs observed without _efd; email attachment URLs have rotating _efd.
remaining_unknowns: Empty FILES → first recording file on an answered call was not watched from in-progress; cannot prove or disprove LAST_UPDATED on that exact transition.
A new real email attachment (added file) was not observed, so 'semantic hash must change on new file' is not practically tested.
name/type/size on FILES were never returned here; unknown whether other Bitrix portals add them.
Non-VOXIMPLANT call providers not observed live.
Deletion / empty successful API responses still not observed.

verdict_notes.Recording_late_fill_behavior_understood: YES with a documented gap: empty→first not watched. Replacement after complete WAS watched and LAST_UPDATED moved.
verdict_notes.Existing_incremental_fetch_sufficient_fo: NEEDS_FIX because current snapshot/files_hash uses RAW FILES including _efd. The LAST_UPDATED incremental cursor itself looked sufficient for observed call completion and recording replacement. Do not treat crm.activity.get as the only activity source.
verdict_notes.Ready_to_design_production_canonical_sta: YES — design schema/invariants/tests next. Do not implement the engine in this step.
